title: A resume of a finished builder or test-author that ran in its own worktree is refused, as for a reviewer
why: Lane agent-name-on-spawn (session_013NEJL1Aq6pKaCrB1kxda68), 09:18 CST Nov 8: it resumed its finished builder by name for a round 1 fix; the worktree was gone, so the worktree-home guard refused every call and the round was lost.
note: Filed 10:17 CST Nov 8 from that lane. Fix: extend rule resume-finished-reviewer (#1917, hooks/guard_merge.py resume_finished_hit) to a builder or test-author spawned with isolation worktree. The test-author resume in the same lane worked only because it fetched a fresh checkout. Related: resume-finished-reviewer-no-tree (doing, #1917's lane); fold there only if that lane takes the scope. Covered by #1974 (10:25 CST Nov 8; lane session_013NEJL3qSsV2LJ6R1a1HMCB, item 409 a): it refuses a resume of any finished agent spawned with worktree isolation, builder and test-author included (5j cases). Done when #1974 merges.
